license: pinned Olympus repository MIT verified in json/unit_and_license_review.json; original external dataset terms and structure mapping unresolved, parent benchmark remains draft
initial_data: exact20 original fixed_fm_pilot per seed; identical across both solver methods and both FM settings

training.initialization: fresh model every cycle; torch seed=dataseed at cycle1, else dataseed+100000*(cycle-1); same across solver/config; no validation

penalty.update: shared AdaptivePenaltyTracker; after each10sample batch,rate<.7 x2,<1 x1.25,otherwise x.85,clip
penalty.lambda: lambda_t=S_t*alpha_t; S=max abs base-FM Ising h,J; zero S gives lambda0

sa.beta_range: Neal automatic per current penalized BQM; record sampler info

candidate_policy: raw10, reject invalid and already evaluated, collapse pool duplicates, choose lowest base-FM predicted unseen feasible candidate; onehot tuple tie break; at most1 accepted; no refill
stop: run all60cycles unless runtime error; no stop for known optimum; no new candidate ->0evaluation but next cycle executes; no budget-limit-as-convergence claim
metrics: best-so-far vs actual BB evaluations and cycles; normalized regret using all192 min/max; accepted counts; raw feasibility; no candidate cycles; optimum initially present versus newly found; training/sampling time; FM/QUBO parity
statistics: all5seeds median/IQR; four paired tests proposed-original within each SA method for final regret and new evaluations; Bonferroni4; retain failures
prevalidation: inherit passed circuit N6/N9/N23 (no QAOA run); reproduce first-cycle checkpoint predictions; penalty equality valid/invalid states; hand-crafted selection/rejection/tie/empty tests; evaluator SHA/budget accounting; shared trainer and sampler audited
interpretation: selected FM config changes rank and decay jointly, individual BBO contributions unseparated; learning-screening test was previously inspected; no QAOA speed/performance claim; true values available only via accepted evaluator calls in solver, exhaustive truth audit separate
